operator: Operator 11/07: build the remaining preregs and run them without per-step approval (read-only studies, no live change, no spend). Standard: docs/TEST_STANDARD.md (EDGE vs PROFITABLE, P2 controls with the 11/07 amendment: PRIMARY control = same-minute other-instrument).
family: 4 SCORED tests: S (confirm-sample read), E, L, R-H2H; one-sided alpha 0.05/4 = 0.0125 each; critical t = scipy t.ppf(1-0.0125, scored days - 1) on per-day means. R21 and R10 individual verdicts are DESCRIPTIVE (not scored). The Fibonacci rerun is not in this family (own prereg + amended_3).
data: ai_reports/warehouse/sip/DAY.npz (120 sessions 2026-04-27..2026-10-15, RTH 1-minute SIP bars) and ai_reports/warehouse/etf/DAY.npz (same days; SMH SOXX IBIT IGV XBI URA XLE XLF ARKK QQQ IWM SPY). Stock universe per day = top 400 by prior-session dollar volume, $10-$500 at the 09:30 open, ETFs/levered products excluded (is_not_stock), prior session = preceding weekday in the file list, 20 prior sessions required for betas/volume baselines. Halves by date at the median scored session.

common.trade: Buy the open of bar t+1, sell the close of bar t+H (hold H bars including the entry bar). Entries 09:45-15:30 (bars 15-360). One trigger per instrument per 30 minutes (first kept; the clock restarts only at a kept trigger). A trigger fires only on the first bar its condition becomes true.
common.cost: Stocks: 6 bp round trip for the primary t, 10 bp stress (binding for PROFITABLE). ETFs (E only): per-ETF round trip = median quoted NBBO spread (bp of mid) from a fixed quote sample + 1 bp, stress = 2x that. Quote sample, fixed now: for each ETF, the 10 sessions with the lowest sha256('etf-cost'|ETF|day), and in each the 20 minutes (09:45-15:30) with the lowest sha256('etf-cost'|ETF|day|minute), the NBBO in force at the start of each minute from Alpaca historical SIP quotes; median over the 200 readings. E STRESS cost per trade = max(2 x the sample round trip, the actual NBBO spread at that trade's entry minute plus at its exit minute, in bp of mid) - quotes fetched for every E trade.
common.controls: PRIMARY: same-minute other-instrument control - the same trade on 5 seeded (sha256(sym|day|label|k)) other instruments of the same kind at the trigger minute t, excluding instruments that triggered in [t-15, t] (known at the decision minute); NO exclusion is based on any trigger after t (that would drop the control trades that surge). Passes the SAME pre-condition filters as the trigger where the hypothesis has one (L). In E, SMH and SOXX never serve as each other's control. SECONDARY: same-instrument later-only control - 5 seeded minutes m in t+H+2 .. t+H+62 (inside 09:45-15:30), clear of [t', t'+H+1] for every trigger t' <= m (no exclusion based on triggers after m), passing the same filters. Report how many control candidates each rule removed.
common.verdict: EDGE = lift vs the PRIMARY control: pooled day-clustered t >= the family critical value (df = scored days - 1) and lift > 0 in EACH half (by date); lift vs the SECONDARY control > 0 pooled; winsorized check (clip the top 1% of per-trade lifts) > 0 in both halves. PROFITABLE = EDGE and net > 0 in both halves and net > 0 at the stress cost. Counts: >= 300 triggers, >= 100 per half, >= 60 scored days and >= 25 per half (S confirm: >= 40 scored days, >= 15 per half), else UNDERPOWERED. Order: VOID, UNDERPOWERED, FAIL (no EDGE), EDGE, PROFITABLE. Information cells never promote a verdict.
common.canary: Run for EACH of S, E, L, R21, R10 with a fixed seed before the read: (a) planted - add +8 bp to every trigger's exit in a copy of the rows; the lift must rise by 8 bp (+-0.5) with controls unchanged; (b) null - triggers re-drawn at random keeping each day's trigger count and the bar-of-day mix; lift within 2 standard errors of 0. Any canary failure = the tool is not trusted and nothing is read.
common.returns: A 1-bar return is close(t)/close(t-1) - 1. If a bar needed by a trigger or a trade (t, t+1 entry open, t+H exit close) is missing, the trade is skipped and counted (reported per hypothesis); no forward-fill except R's minute grid.
common.baseline_void: Baseline = random minutes weighted to the triggers' bar-of-day distribution, drawn from the hypothesis's OWN control pool: for each trigger, one random instrument at the same bar-of-day (seed 'baseline'|hyp|k): E: the 12 ETFs; L: universe stocks passing the same [-15, +2] bp residual 2-bar filter at that minute; S/R: universe stocks. Same trade and cost. A PRIMARY control mean more than 3 bp from it = VOID, no exceptions.
common.feed: Every result here is on SIP bars; none has been shown on IEX (except the R information cell below). A pass is not a live change.

S_surge_continuation_stocks.claim: C2 component: surge continuation, found as an R5 information cell on the 120-day warehouse (+2 bp vs random, t 5.4).
S_surge_continuation_stocks.trigger: The R5 rule UNCHANGED (tools/studies/regime_beta_family.py stock_stats + surge_events): residual 1-bar return res1 = r1 - beta x SPY r1 >= 0.0020, beta from residual_stats over the previous 20 sessions as R5; volume ratio = v(t) / MEAN(v[t-15..t-1]) >= 2.0 with >= 10 non-missing bars; refractory 30 min; bars 60-360 as R5 afternoon events plus 15-59 (all RTH 09:45-15:30).
S_surge_continuation_stocks.samples: VERDICT on ai_reports/warehouse_confirm/sip (70 sessions 2026-01-14..04-24, after a 20-session warm-up). The 120-day read is reported as a RE-SCORE OF THE DISCOVERY SAMPLE and is information only.
information: H = 10 and 30 (entries capped at bar 359 for H = 30)

E_surge_continuation_etfs.claim: B1: the same surge rule on the 12 thematic/broad ETFs, where costs are small, is PROFITABLE.
E_surge_continuation_etfs.trigger: As S's rule on each ETF bar series; for SPY itself the raw 1-bar return (no residual). SMH and SOXX are near duplicates: when both trigger in the same minute keep only SMH.
E_surge_continuation_etfs.controls_note: PRIMARY = same minute, 5 seeded OTHER ETFs (same trade); SECONDARY = same ETF later-only.
E_surge_continuation_etfs.count_rule: An outcome-blind count runs first. If E has < 300 triggers at 20 bp it uses ONE fallback threshold fixed now, 10 bp, chosen only on the count; if still < 300 it is UNDERPOWERED. The family divisor does not change.

R_pctr_length_10_vs_21.claim: X10 (replay could not test it): the live pre-square arm computed with a fast %R length of 10 instead of 21 finds better entries.
R_pctr_length_10_vs_21.trigger_L: Live pre-square (ai_entry_watch.py:13087-13148): both fast and slow >= -35, |fast - slow| <= 15, NOT (both >= -20), and fast(t) - fast(t-1) > 0.05, true on 2 consecutive bars; the trigger is the second bar. fast = %R(L) EWM span 7, slow = %R(112) EWM span 3, on the minute grid (missing minutes filled flat as signals._minute_grid_pr), warmed up on the previous session's last 112 RTH bars. Entries 09:45-15:30.
R_pctr_length_10_vs_21.test: SCORED: R-H2H = per day, the mean PRIMARY-control lift of L=10 minus that of L=21, on days with both arms (>= 60). L=10 is BETTER if the pooled day-clustered t of that per-day difference >= the family critical value (df = those days - 1) AND the mean difference > 0 in each date half. R21 and R10 individual EDGE/PROFITABLE verdicts are DESCRIPTIVE. REQUIRED information cell: repeat R on ai_reports/warehouse/iex; it must point the same way before any live use.

L_sector_etf_lead_lag.claim: N5: when a stock's sector ETF jumps and the stock has not moved yet, the stock catches up.
L_sector_etf_lead_lag.mapping: Each universe stock is mapped (per day, from the previous 20 sessions only) to the ETF among SMH SOXX IBIT IGV XBI URA XLE XLF ARKK whose SPY-residual 1-minute returns have the highest correlation with the stock's, if that correlation >= 0.30; otherwise unmapped.
L_sector_etf_lead_lag.trigger: At bar t the mapped ETF's 2-bar SPY-residual return = [close(t)/close(t-2) - 1] - beta x [SPY close(t)/close(t-2) - 1] >= +15 bp and its volume(t) >= 2 x MEAN(volume t-15..t-1); and the stock's own residual 2-bar return, defined the same way with the stock's beta, is in [-15, +2] bp. Buy the stock.
L_sector_etf_lead_lag.controls_note: PRIMARY = same minute, 5 seeded universe stocks that pass the same [-15, +2] bp residual 2-bar filter and are NOT mapped to the trigger ETF or to any ETF whose prior-20-session residual correlation with it is >= 0.5. SECONDARY = the same stock later-only, passing the same filter.
L_sector_etf_lead_lag.count_rule: Besides the common counts: >= 60 distinct ETF events (ETF x minute) and >= 25 per half, else UNDERPOWERED.
